rules.text:
Rules this redesign follows

• One "Your next step" box at the top of every page: a plain sentence and at most one big button.

• Six status words, used everywhere: Done · Working · Waiting for you · Not yet · Stopped · Problem.

• Issues are named by number, date and charity — never by a run id.

• No jargon on editor pages: no run, trigger, pipeline, re-roll, tokens or agent names. Machinery lives behind "Behind the scenes".

• Every button does what it says. Nothing is drawn disabled or dead.

• Editing is a page you click into and type on. Each part has one small "Rewrite this part" helper.
